intuition: Each bit contributed by triplicated values appears a multiple of three times.

brute_force.approach: Count complete integer frequencies and find the value whose count is one.

optimal.approach: Sum each of the 32 bit positions modulo three, then interpret the result as a signed 32-bit integer.

edge_cases: The unique value may be negative.
The unique value may be zero.
Sign handling must convert a set high bit back from two's-complement form.
